notes: ODL-947 follow-up (t_370d2664): the access report is checked against a number this boot can have. The installer re-embeds installer/access_report.sh (7c5629c2…, 5,322 bytes): the wrapper passes the image pin as --expect only when this boot's own report agrees with it, and otherwise passes the boot's own measurement and names both numbers on one line — a pin is a file's measurement (an empty command line and the builder's vCPU count), while a tenant's boot line is per machine, so the seal row failed at every boot of an image that had its pin and odile-access-report never started (odile-release-setup.sh logs the same disagreement for the installer). This cut is 2026.11.25-1 over main's 2026.11.23-9 (the ODL-947 follow-up on the seeded first boot: install-stack.sh's production branch writes the seed's verifier when the .env does not hold it and stamps only after the write, and installer.ensure_env does the same on a run that finds a placeholder and keeps a hash the owner's own visit recorded), which carries 2026.11.23-8 (ODL-926's one-code cut). Against -9 only installer_sha256, the manifest and this document's hashes move; no skill, page or template changed.
